What operating and financial assumptions do these results depend on?

These results apply within the following scope and assumptions.

Calculation scope

Compare the listed complete deployments against the supplied staffing, timing, recorded access and spending requirements. Expense-recovery guest counts are conditional financial thresholds. Choice and authorization remain outside this app; customer response and profit are not forecast. The calculation does not measure causal promotion effectiveness or identify a profit-maximizing deployment.

Material assumptions
Staff availability, required venue coverage, activity durations and recorded access remain applicable for the operating evening.
Each additional guest used in the financial comparison is genuinely incremental. Contribution and losses from discounting existing customers are supplied assumptions.
Complete additional deployment expense and any supplied existing-customer discount loss must both be covered. Nonpositive contribution cannot support an ordinary break-even guest threshold.
